title: CTLE
text: Models continuous time linear equalizer (CTLE), 1 input, 1 output, {Mode} sets CTLE operating mode; {Slice select} selects which corner of 3D GPZ matrix, {Configuration select} selects which member of transfer function to apply in fixed, {Specification} sets the input specification for CTLE response, {DC gain (dB)} sets the gain at zero frequency, {Peaking gain (dB)} sets the difference between AC and DC gain, {AC gain (dB)} sets the gain at peaking frequency, {Peaking frequency (Hz)} sets the approximate frequency at which CTLE transfer function peaks, {Gain pole zero matrix}, {Visualize Response} plots CTLE response and {Launch CTLE Fitter App} sets the launch CTLE Fitter. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Mode
params.values: CTLE operating mode Adapt (default) | Off | Fixed

params.name: Slice select
params.values: Select which corner of 3D GPZ matrix to use 0 (default) | nonegative scalar integer

params.name: Configuration select
params.values: Select which member of transfer function to apply in fixed mode 0 (default) | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8

params.name: Specification
params.values: Input specification for CTLE response ’DC Gain and Peaking Gain’ (default) | ’DC Gain and AC Gain’ | ’AC Gain and Peaking Gain’ | ’GPZ Matrix’

params.name: DC gain (dB)
params.values: Gain at zero frequency [0:-1:-8] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Peaking gain (dB)
params.values: Difference between AC and DC gain [0:8] (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: AC gain (dB)
params.values: Gain at peaking frequency 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Peaking frequency (Hz)
params.values: Approximate frequency at which CTLE transfer function peaks 5e9 (default) | scalar | vector
